[[File:Mustafarian_Weaponsmith_SM.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] weaponsmith]]
'''Weaponsmith''', also known as '''Armstech''', was an occupation that specialized in the construction, modification and repair of weapons. [[Daw Sembian]] was a weaponsmith. They worked hard metals, alloys and synthetic materials to craft [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], blaster modifications and [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]].

[[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] was noted for its master weaponsmiths who designed the company's droid [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] such as the [[SD-9 battle droid|SD-9]] and [[SD-10 battle droid]]s.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Prior to the "New Game Enhancements" of [[2005]], Weaponsmith was one of many profession in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
